mapper.select: select id, parent_id AS parentId, alert_id AS alertId, event, handler, handler_name AS handlerName, event_handler_id AS eventHandlerId, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, status, error, config AS configStr, result AS resultStr from alert_event_handler_audit where id = #{value}

select a.id, a.parent_id AS parentId, a.alert_id AS alertId, a.event, a.handler, a.handler_name AS handlerName, a.event_handler_id AS eventHandlerId, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, (select is_async from alert_event_handler x where x.id = a.event_handler_id) as isAsync, a.status, a.error, a.config AS configStr, a.result AS resultStr from alert_event_handler_audit a where a.alert_id = #{alertId} order by a.id desc

select id, alert_id as alertId, input_user as inputUser, input_from as inputFrom, input_time as inputTime, attr_name as attrName, old_value as oldValueListStr, new_value as newValueListStr from alert_audit
order by id desc limit #{startNum}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: insert into alert_audit (id, alert_id, input_user, input_from, input_time, attr_name, old_value, new_value) values (#{id}, #{alertId}, #{inputUser}, #{inputFrom}, now(), #{attrName}, #{oldValueListStr, typeHandler=CompressHandler}, #{newValueListStr, typeHandler=CompressHandler})
